title: Define all-filter robustness audit protocol
description: Create the operating rule for Filter Controller work so user examples are treated as signals for a full audit, not as the whole implementation scope.
objective: Prevent one-off fixes by requiring source-grounded findings across all affected filter types before implementation tasks are created.
inputs_required: Guilherme feedback that Range and Rating are examples, not isolated requests
expected_outputs: Rule that each filter request requires per-type and cross-cutting audit classification
Finding template with source path, control ID, preset field, render selector, failure mode, and recommended next task
acceptance_criteria: The protocol explicitly says not to fix only the named example when the user is describing a system-wide problem.
The protocol separates analysis, implementation planning, and test creation.
The protocol preserves Guilherme as final QA for complex visual/editor interactions.
Every later robustness task can cite the protocol as its acceptance source.
verification: Memory decision is updated with the example-as-signal rule.

budgets.context_budget: current Filter Controller tasks, user feedback, QA boundary memory

risks: Without this protocol, future work may keep repairing only Range or Rating and miss shared contracts.
